scope: Previously used development12 tasks, 3 planned seeds; this release reports only the complete first-seed paired block, not the full72.
nl_definition: Deterministic prose rendering of the SAME revisable per-agent v2 state; preserves layer, holder/source, time and uncertainty. Not an independently generated NL summarizer.
controls: Same frozen updater, observation/action feedback/delivered communication access, planner, backbone, action interface and update timing. Different closed-loop actions may yield different trajectories.
token_accounting: Provider-reported usage summed from received response.json files once per request. Reasoning tokens included in completion_tokens. Failed requests without response may incur unreported cost; probes and interrupted second-seed rollout excluded from first-seed cost table.
failure_policy: All completed first-seed results retained, including task failures and one service-affected NL run. Incomplete second-seed run preserved separately; no resampling or post-hoc replacement.
physical_scoring: strict_physical_v2, all goals satisfied for strict success; mean per-rollout goal completion, not pooled goals.
not_included: Raw videos, credentials, datasets and per-call prompt/response bodies are not published in this compact result release. Hashes identify local audit artifacts; they are not independent validation of the trajectories.
